question: Which three customers have the most open tickets?

replies:
{"type": "answer_plan", "interpretation": "Answer to: Which three customers have the most open tickets?", "sql": "SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(*) AS open_tickets
FROM support_tickets t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.resolved_at IS NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY open_tickets DESC
LIMIT 3"}
